tools.name: retainful_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts (profiles) in the Retainful organization, one page at a time, with consent status and source. Retainful API: GET /customer.

tools.name: retainful_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact (profile) by its Retainful id (contactUUID), with its attributes. Retainful API: GET /customer/{id}.

tools.name: retainful_list_lists
tools.description: List the lists and segments in the organization with their ids. Use the id as list_id in retainful_add_contact_to_list. Retainful API: GET /contact-groups.

tools.name: retainful_get_list
tools.description: Get one list or segment by its id. Retainful API: GET /contact-groups/{id}.

tools.name: retainful_upsert_contact
tools.description: WRITE: create a contact, or update it when the email or phone already exists. Does not add anyone to a list. email_opt_in is required: it sets marketing consent, so send SUBSCRIBED only with real consent. Needs email or phone. Retainful API: POST /customer/create.

tools.name: retainful_add_contact_to_list
tools.description: WRITE: create or update a contact by email and add them to a list in one call. A list can start an automation. email_opt_in is required: an existing contact is set to SUBSCRIBED when it is omitted here. Retainful API: POST /contact-groups/{listId}/contacts.

tools.name: retainful_track_event
tools.description: WRITE: record one event on a contact's timeline. Automations triggered by the event can email the contact. Reuse the same unique_identifier only for a retry of the same real occurrence (a repeat does not trigger automations again); use a new one for each new occurrence. Event data must be flat: stri

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: retainful_upsert_contact, retainful_add_contact_to_list · Private data: retainful_list_contacts, retainful_get_contact, retainful_list_lists, retainful_get_list, retainful_upsert_contact, retainful_add_contact_to_list, retainful_track_event · Public sink: retainful_upsert_contact, retainful_add_contact_to_list, retainful_track_event.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: retainful_upsert_contact, retainful_add_contact_to_list · Private data: retainful_list_contacts, retainful_get_contact, retainful_list_lists, retainful_get_list, retainful_upsert_contact, retainful_add_contact_to_list, retainful_track_event · Public sink: retainful_upsert_contact, retainful_add_contact_to_list, retainful_track_event

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
